Module com.example.fortune_cookies_app
Package com.example.fortune_cookies_app.controller

Class CalendarMainController

java.lang.Object
com.example.fortune_cookies_app.controller.CalendarMainController
public class CalendarMainController extends Object
The CalendarMainController class is responsible for managing the main calendar interface of the application. It provides functionalities for displaying the calendar, navigating between months, updating the user interface with user-specific data, handling event highlights, and managing sidebar content.
